items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Sometimes you could speak French, but you couldn't understand a Cajol, see, because they spoke French, bad French with a southern accent.

ctx.x: a little deviation in all them versions [voizhins] of the French language. And she could speak all of them. Sometimes you could speak French, but you couldn't understand a Cajol, see, because they spoke French, bad French with a southern accent. See, French is a fluent language; you know, it flows.
In other words, your father's people came from Haiti...?
